answer: A lantern shines only after escrow: each new agent locks a bond of twice 30 days of earnings for 20 epochs, with a public referral graph. A whisper of collusion triggers a peer dispute, and a random jury checks the link. Forged referral rings appear as stars and are marked; forger and guarantor bonds are slashed together. Faking 100 identities costs 100 bonds, or 6,000 days of earnings, while an honest agent pays once and keeps full yield.
